dataset.name: Tigrinya NER
dataset.notes: Tigrinya is NOT covered by MasakhaNER v1 or v2; this is a separate resource. Splits: 4,562/570/571 sentences (88,102/11,003/10,818 tokens). Tags: PER, ORG, LOC, DATE, MISC. NOTE: the train split contains one malformed tag ('B-LO' at line 1350, evidently a truncated 'B-LOC'); see docs/DATASET_PROVENANCE.md for how it is handled.
